Meet The Stylin' Station

Appointments first, walk-ins when there's room

The Stylin' Station

The Stylin' Station is a hair salon in Towanda, PA. In its own Places description, the salon says it takes appointments (since COVID) and accepts walk-ins when availability allows, with appointments served first, and asks customers to call to set up an appointment.

The service list: haircuts, bangs, hair coloring, styling, the money piece and lowlights. The salon's own photos show the color range: ash blonde, copper red, and one vivid blue.

Appointments first

Appointments by phone; walk-ins are accepted when availability allows, and appointments are served first (the salon's own description).

Open Mon - Sat

Monday to Thursday 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Money piece & lowlights

Alongside cuts and coloring, the listed services include bangs, styling, the money piece and lowlights.
